blocks.x: Well did Cab ever have a hit record?
That was, I didn't know whether that was an expression....
And then "Jim Jam Jumpin'." You remember "Jim Jam Jumpin' with the jumpin' jive." That was a hit.
Because as you said he was one of the best paying band.
He certainly could afford to have the best playing band.
Oh yeah, yeah. He and Duke were the highest paid bands out there. And that was the going salary, $100 a week. Everybody jumped at that.
Plus it was a great band to play with.
